code:
// Customer Status
IF ISNULL([Last Qualifying Order Date]) THEN "Never Purchased"
ELSEIF DATEDIFF('day', [Last Qualifying Order Date],
    [As Of Date]) <= 90 THEN "Active"
ELSEIF [Purchases Prior 12 Months] >= 2 THEN "Churned"
ELSE "Not Yet Retained"
END
